recipe.name: Supply of SPC Flooring which features a total thickness of 4+1 mm, including an integrated IXPE underlay that provides superior sound absorption and enhanced walking comfort. The flooring offers excellent dimensional stability (≤ 0.17%) and minimal curling (≤ 2 mm). With a wear layer thickness of no less than +0.3 mm and a density range of 1.98–2.05 g/cc, it ensures outstanding strength, resilience, and surface integrity. The precision locking system provides a locking strength of ≥ 2.5 kN/m, ensuring excellent joint integrity and long-lasting performance. The surface delivers AC6 wear resistance and a refined gloss level of 5–8 GU. The flooring also demonstrates high peel strength (≥ 90 N) and meets Bfl-S1 fire-resistance standards, ensuring safety, durability, and reliability under demanding conditions.

recipe.name: Cleaning of water tanks, Sumps and PVC/RCC tank through ‘T’ clean process undertaking cleaning by using latest German state of art technology with High pressure Rotary Jet cleaning and usage of the most effective Anti-bacterial agents, which is Bio degradable and echo friendly in nature, UV radiation in following stages: 1. First stage of Mechanized dewatering, 2. Cleaning of wall and ceiling to the sump with high pressure rotary jet which dislodges the layer of dirt and algae, 3. Dirty water and sludge are removed by using sludge pump, 4. Removing dirt is again removed by using industrial vacuum, 5. Treatment of wall ceiling roof with anti-bacterial liquid (which is bio degradable and eco-friendly in nature), 6. Final important treatment is ultra violet radiation which kills suspended or floating bacteria(for sumps)
